video_title: Minnesota Timberwolves Content Day as an NBA Player

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on Serena Williams' longevity in professional sports
quotes.excerpt: her longevity, I think that's something that is very underestimated in today's society.
quotes.quote: Serena Williams, because her longevity, I think that's something that is very underestimated in today's society. Being able to do something for 20, 25 years at a high level, that's something that is very hard. It takes sacrifice, that takes a lot of dedication and hard work.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on the importance of voting in local elections
quotes.excerpt: it is very important to have your voice be heard when it comes to voting.
quotes.quote: I think it is very important to have your voice be heard when it comes to voting because most of the laws and anything, whether sports, just natural living in America, it all comes from a vote. Each vote matters. Whatever way you think, that's your right to your own opinion, but you never want to not have the opportunity to be able to vote. 60, 80 years ago, our ancestors did not have the ability, so I think now taking advantage of that is very important.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on building team chemistry during the off-season
quotes.excerpt: It's been great building the chemistry. I think that's very important in terms of trying to compete.
quotes.quote: It's been great building the chemistry. I think that's very important in terms of trying to compete for a championship and being in those long playoff series and just being together throughout the whole season. I think that's very important now.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu on his transition to the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: when I got here to trade deadline, it's been nothing but love.
quotes.quote: It means a lot. I'm very excited. When I got here to trade deadline, it's been nothing but love. The coaching staff, the fans, my teammates, they all welcome me with open arms. And now I'm able to have a full off-season together with the guys and continue to build on our offensive, defensive schematics, and I think that's something that I'm very excited, I'm looking forward to.
